$comment: Single source of the .env settings. configure.bat prompts for these and writes .env; it also regenerates .env.example from them. To add a setting: add an entry here (and to app/backend/app/config.py if the backend reads it). tests/test_settings_schema.py keeps the two in sync. Types: host, port, int, number, relpath, string, roots (name=folder;name=folder, '-' clears it), secret (prompted hidden, never written to .env.example).

settings.name: ARCHEION_HOST
settings.description: Address the backend listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless other machines must reach it.

settings.name: ARCHEION_PORT
settings.description: Backend port (workspace AI / Agent APIs range, see ../CLAUDE.md).

settings.name: ARCHEION_DB_PATH
settings.description: The backend's SQLite database (admin credential hash, sessions, feedback), relative to the repo root.

settings.name: ARCHEION_WORKSPACE_ROOT
settings.description: Optional: a folder holding projects, relative to the repo root (e.g. ..), granted as the root named workspace. Registry pages without root: resolve inside it. Empty by default, so nothing is granted until you add a root (ADR 0012); prefer named roots, from the viewer's Settings page. Type - to clear it.

settings.name: ARCHEION_ROOTS
settings.description: More folders projects may live in, as name=folder;name=folder (ADR 0008). A registry page picks one with root: <name>. Granting a folder lets Archeion read projects in it; leave it empty for none. Type - to clear it.

settings.name: ARCHEION_REGISTRY_DIR
settings.description: Your private project registry, relative to the repo root. It must stay gitignored. setup.bat creates it from registry.example/.

settings.name: ARCHEION_STUDY_KEEP
settings.description: How many code study snapshots to keep per project in registry/studies/ (ADR 0019). Saving a new study prunes the oldest beyond this.

settings.name: ARCHEION_FRONTEND_PORT
settings.description: Frontend dev server port (Vite). It proxies /api to the backend.

settings.name: ARCHEION_SESSION_IDLE_HOURS
settings.description: Log out after this many hours without activity.

settings.name: ARCHEION_SESSION_MAX_DAYS
settings.description: Log out this many days after login at the latest.
